Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The agent misinterpreted key clues and produced a class list that violates the stated constraints. They assigned Druid as “the bear” (likely a Hunter’s bear pet) and used Demon Hunter for Metamorphosis instead of Warlock. This led to a lineup with only one plate wearer (Paladin) instead of the required two, and unnecessary duplication of leather wearers. A consistent mapping would use Death Knight (Frost for “ice”), Warlock (Fire and Metamorphosis), Hunter (bear pet), Paladin (holy tank), and Priest (holy healer), satisfying the “two plate, two cloth” condition and explaining why a Shaman-only kilt is unusable.
